description: This Java source file implements the ClientTransactionReadPlatformService interface, providing methods for retrieving client transaction data, including fetching all transactions with pagination, fetching by charge, and retrieving specific transactions by ID or external ID. It uses JDBC template for database access, constructs SQL queries dynamically, and maps result sets to data transfer objects.

classes.name: ClientTransactionMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set to ClientTransactionData objects. It constructs the SQL schema string for query selection and maps each row to DTO, including handling associated payment details and currency data.

classes.name: ClientTransactionReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Main service class implementing data retrieval methods for client transactions, including pagination support and handling specific transaction retrieval by ID and external ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllTransactions
methods.description: Fetches paginated list of all transactions for a specific client, applying search parameters for limit and offset.

methods.name: retrieveAllTransactions
methods.description: Fetches all transactions for a specific client and optional charge ID without pagination.

methods.name: retrieveTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a specific transaction by client ID and transaction ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: retrieveTransactionByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves a transaction using its external ID via repository lookup.
